1879470902.desc: Long have the people of Middle-earth rued the power of the Enemy to twist that which is good to its own dark ends - but now and again the truest craftsmen among the Free People find a way to redeem some of the darkest works and materials of the Enemy, and bind them to true and good purpose again. So it is with the mythical Silk-hide armours, woven from strands of silk taken from the dark brood of Shelob and her ilk, wound with strips of hide into the leather itself to craft armour of surpassing strength and lightness. Would that all such workings of the enemy could come to such elegant ends.

1879484598.name: Bellassamdir
1879484598.desc: An early endeavour in the craft of ring-making made prior to the forging of the rings of power, this unique device possesses great strength nevertheless. Such rings have appeared on occasion throughout the history of Middle-earth, seemingly never staying with one master for long. This artifact is one of the few powers that might counter the strength of the greater rings, if only for a little while.
